description: Real-Time Midblock Traffic Data is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This near real-time (15-minute refresh) dataset comprises raw directional traffic volume and speed by travel lane collected at the City of Winnipeg’s continuous count stations. This data has not been reviewed for validity and may be impacted by equipment error. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. Its tags are real-time, count, volume, road, midblock. The table has 38 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
